queries: WITH college_income AS (SELECT ma.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN major AS ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id WHERE ma.college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.college) SELECT college, total_income, CAST(total_income AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(total_income) OVER (), 0) AS income_fraction FROM college_income ORDER BY college
